goal: Allows Bitcoin Core wallet users to fund, create, and fee-bump transactions paying to BIP 352 addresses
Prevents address reuse and improves privacy for silent payment recipients via wallet RPCs and the GUI
reviewability: Reviewable now, though an MSVC build failure in walletmodel.cpp is not yet resolved
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob)
Unaddressed objection: MSVC build failure in walletmodel.cpp (Yudis-bit)
Unresolved objection: fee bumping erases recipient records if original tx is mined (Yudis-bit)
Unresolved objection: replaced txs lose silent payment identity across wallet restarts (Yudis-bit)
Suggests moving BIP 352 scanning RPC or test scanner to a separate PR (rustaceanrob)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it enables sending to BIP 352 silent payment addresses for greater recipient privacy
Unblocks subsequent silent payments wallet functionality
